result.brief: 提出三阶段框架，用JEPA式视觉预测从第一视角人类视频学习效果感知的潜在动作，并联合预测未来视觉动态与潜在动作，实现跨本体免重定向的灵巧操作迁移。
result.reason: Learns JEPA-style latent action representations and a latent-action world model from egocentric video, decoupling human priors from robot control; representation contribution plus embodied world modeling.
